info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Payments Payments Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Payment Status Query API provides a mechanism for retrieving the current status of payments within the system. Users can utilize this endpoint to check on payments they have initiated, allowing for effective tracking and management of financial transactions. This capability is valuable for businesses and financial institutions that need to monitor payment processes and ensure timely completion. Typical consumers include developers and financial analysts looking to integrate or analyze payment status information in their applications.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of a payment.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of a payment. You can use this to check if a payment is processed, pending, or failed, providing essential information for further actions or user notifications.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to check the status of payments. It should contain the necessary information as defined in the schema to retrieve the current status.

200.description: The current payment status has been successfully retrieved.

ListPaymentsPaymentsStatusRequest.description: A representation of the request body for the GET operations related to payment status.

ListPaymentsPaymentsStatusResponse_200.title: Payment Status Response

status.description: Indicates whether the payment status retrieval was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number associated with the payment.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the payment processing.

state.description: The current state of the payment.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the payment status request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional details about the payment status.

ListPaymentsPaymentsStatusResponse_200.description: Represents the response from the payment status API, containing information about the payment status and related details.
